title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30290: Add OnBeforeUpdateSetupOnBillToCustomerChangeInSalesHeader event
summary: A new integration event OnBeforeUpdateSetupOnBillToCustomerChangeInSalesHeader is added to the Sales Header table to allow extensions to override or skip the standard VAT registration update logic when the bill-to customer changes.
key_points: Event has IsHandled parameter that allows subscribers to prevent standard logic execution
Change applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, NA, BE, CH, CZ, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NL, NO, RU, SE, APAC)
Enables extensions to implement custom VAT registration and posting group assignment without conflicts
Maintains backward compatibility as event is optional
